# gitmoap_service_account_token (Resource)

Mints a token that acts as the service account, carrying the scopes you name, with an optional expiry and an optional binding to one group or repository you can see. A token carries everything the account can do, so only someone who may manage the account — and holds at least its access — may mint one: the owners for a group's account, Maintainers and above for a repository's. The response holds the token itself once, and never again. At most 100 tokens per account.

The token needs `token:manage` and `token:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `sa_id` (String) Service account ID
- `scopes` (List of String)

### Optional

- `expires_in_days` (Number) Days until the token expires. Omit for a non-expiring token.
- `resource` (Attributes) Restricts a token to a single group subtree or repository (GitHub
fine-grained-PAT style). Omit for a token usable across everything the
principal can already reach. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resource))

### Read-Only

- `access_token` (Attributes) An access token, without its secret: who it belongs to, its scopes, what it is limited to, and
when it expires and was last used. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_token))
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The plaintext token. Store it securely — it is not shown again.

<a id="nestedatt--resource"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resource`

Optional:

- `scope_id` (String)
- `scope_type` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--access_token"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access_token`

Read-Only:

- `access_token_id` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `expires_at` (String)
- `last_used_at` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `oauth` (Attributes) The connected app behind a token. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_token--oauth))
- `principal_id` (String)
- `principal_kind` (String) The kind of principal an access token authenticates as.
- `resource_scope_id` (String)
- `resource_scope_type` (String)
- `scopes` (List of String)

<a id="nestedatt--access_token--oauth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access_token.oauth`

Read-Only:

- `client_name` (String)
- `grant_id` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by its sa_id and access_token_id, joined with slashes.
terraform import gitmoap_service_account_token.example "<sa_id>/<access_token_id>"
```
